chapter.title: Systems people can enter
chapter.thread: Turn complex systems into places people can understand.

worlds.title: Renault 5 Turbo 3E
worlds.summary: A cinematic WebGL tribute built around exploration, annotated vehicle details and a twenty-step sequence.
worlds.visitor: Move through a real-time vehicle scene, shift viewpoints and uncover details through a guided spatial narrative.
worlds.notice: Fan-made study. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Renault or Renault Group.

worlds.title: Gaussian Splatting Web
worlds.summary: A browser laboratory for navigating captured volume through splats, custom shaders, fog and camera controls.
worlds.visitor: Orbit a spatial capture, alter field of view and atmosphere, and study how a point field becomes a place.

worlds.title: MAVI
worlds.summary: Museo Accesible Virtual Interactivo: a digital museum conceived as an open route into culture.
worlds.visitor: Enter a virtual museum, follow a spatial story and encounter cultural material through an accessible interface.

worlds.title: Dreamly
worlds.summary: A travel assistant whose visible architecture connects clarification, retrieval, evidence checks and guardrails.
worlds.visitor: Trace how a request becomes a grounded response instead of treating intelligence as an unexplained black box.

worlds.title: KOVA
worlds.summary: An agent administration system that guides provider, backend and channel configuration through one visible control surface.
worlds.visitor: Configure a model provider, connect an agent backend and inspect channels, deployment paths and the security pipeline.

worlds.title: SolarScope
worlds.summary: A browser-side photovoltaic configurator for exploring components, physical losses, generation and long-horizon scenarios.
worlds.visitor: Shape a residential solar installation, compare assumptions and read the engineering consequences as a system.

principles: Keep the human in the loop.

fieldNotes.title: Spatial interfaces
fieldNotes.text: Navigation, camera and depth become useful when they help someone form a mental model.

fieldNotes.title: Visible intelligence
fieldNotes.text: Sources, decisions and limits belong in the interface—not behind the curtain.

fieldNotes.title: Accessible culture
fieldNotes.text: Digital space can widen access to culture instead of merely reproducing a physical room.

signature: Construyo tecnología para ampliar la imaginación humana.
